entities.summary: Dwayne Lee Bacon Jr. is an American professional basketball player for the Dubai Basketball of the ABA League and the EuroLeague. He has also played for the Charlotte Hornets and the Orlando Magic in the National Basketball Association (NBA). Bacon played college basketball for the Florida State Seminoles.
